logp.method_description: The lipophilicity (log Po/w) of Ir1-Ir5 was determined using a shake-flask ultraviolet absorptive spectrophotometry method. Octanol-saturated water and watersaturated octanol were prepared by mixing octanol with saline. Equal volumes of stock solutions of Ir1-Ir5 in octanol-saturated water were added to water-saturated octanol, and the mixture was shaken at 60 rpm at 25 °C to allow for partitioning. After 24 h, the two phases (n-octanol and water) were separated, centrifuged at 3,000 rpm for 10 min, and the supernatant was collected.
